Model Text Summary:
A narrative poem by Mary Dow Brine depicting empathy in action on a snowy winter afternoon. An frail, elderly woman stands helpless at a busy city street crossing while crowds pass by indifferently. A young, cheerful schoolboy steps out from his group of friends, offers his assistance, and gently guides her across the street. He explains to his peers that she is 'somebody's mother', hoping another kind soul will help his own mother if she is ever old and vulnerable.
